Institutional Catalog & Eligibility Matrix

Standardized Loan Referral Catalog & Checklists

Enable your connectors to match borrowers with the right institutional lender program on the first attempt, preventing multiple rejected credit inquiries.

Product Matrix

Institutional Loan Categories

Indicative terms and required documentation checklists configured across active institutional lending partners.

MSME Category

MSME Express Booster Loan

₹2,00,000 to ₹50,00,000

Fast-track working capital financing for registered MSME enterprises, manufacturing units in industrial corridors (such as Nacharam IDA and Mallapur), and wholesale commercial distributors.

Min. CIBIL Score: 650+
Min. Monthly Turnover: ₹50,000
Indicative Rate: 11.50% - 16.00% p.a.
Turnaround SLA: 24 Hours
Required Checklist: Udyam MSME Registration Certificate, Entity PAN Card, 6 Months Bank Statements (Current Account), Income Tax Returns (2 Years), GST Returns.
Commercial Category

Business Working Capital Growth Loan

₹5,00,000 to ₹1,00,00,000

Unsecured and partially collateralized business expansion credit for established private limited companies, partnerships, and proprietorships with proven operational history.

Min. CIBIL Score: 700+
Min. Monthly Turnover: ₹1,00,000
Indicative Rate: 12.25% - 17.00% p.a.
Turnaround SLA: 36 Hours
Required Checklist: Entity PAN, GST Returns (12 Months), Audited Balance Sheet & P&L (2 Years), 6 Months Primary Bank Statements, Business Address Proof.
Retail Mortgage

Housing Finance & Mortgage Facility

₹15,00,000 to ₹5,00,00,000

Home purchase loans, construction funding, and balance transfers for salaried and self-employed individuals buying residential property in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.

Min. CIBIL Score: 720+
Min. Monthly Income: ₹40,000
Indicative Rate: 8.45% - 9.75% p.a.
Turnaround SLA: 48 Hours
Required Checklist: Identity & Address Proof, Property Link Documents (30-year search), Sale Agreement, Form 16 / ITR 3 Years, 6 Months Salary Account Statements.
Unsecured Retail

Salaried Personal Prime Loan

₹50,000 to ₹25,00,000

Unsecured personal financing for corporate, government, and IT professionals working across Hyderabad, Secunderabad, and Telangana urban clusters.

Min. CIBIL Score: 680+
Min. Monthly Income: ₹25,000
Indicative Rate: 10.75% - 15.50% p.a.
Turnaround SLA: 24 Hours
Required Checklist: PAN Card, Aadhaar / Passport, 3 Months Bank Statements, 3 Months Latest Salary Slips, Employer ID.
Underwriting Policy Notice: All figures, rates, CIBIL thresholds, and maximum amounts listed are indicative and configured by partner institutional lenders. Zippy Enterprises does not underwrite or approve credit. Sanctions are governed by the respective lender's internal risk and credit assessment committee.
